lines.text: Sing to the LORD a new song,
His right hand and holy arm
The LORD has proclaimed His salvation
and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
He has remembered His love and faithfulness
all the ends of the earth
have seen the salvation of our God.

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saul and David — the young man bent over the harp while the troubled king listens behind the curtain, a Psalm: sing to the LORD a new song
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_lied

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, The Miraculous Draught of Fishes — Christ standing on the water with His hand raised while the net comes up heavy, for He has done wonders by His right hand and holy arm
pictures.name: pd_witz_wonder

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, The Resurrection of Christ — Christ rising in the golden light while the angels lift the slab and the guards sleep, He has gained Him the victory and proclaimed His salvation
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_overwinning

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Baptism of the Eunuch — Philip with his hand raised over the Ethiopian official kneeling by the road, His righteousness revealed to the nations
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_volken

pictures.scene: Giandomenico Tiepolo, The Three Angels appearing to Abraham — Abraham face down on the ground before the angel who leans over him pointing, the promise remembered to the house of Israel
pictures.name: pd_tiepolo_israel

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — the oldest king kneeling with his hands joined and his crown set down on the broken stones, all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_heil
